I’m not able to submit the vote directly from here, but I can show you exactly how to do it yourself using the VirusTotal API.  
Here’s what you’ll need:

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| **Endpoint** | `POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes` |
| **Headers** | `x-apikey: <your_api_key>` (replace `<your_api_key>` with your actual key) |
| **Body** | `{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}` |

### Example cURL Command

```bash
curl -X POST \
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes \
     -H "x-apikey: key_four" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}'
```

### Using Python (`requests`)

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "key_four",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload = {
    "type": "vote",
    "attributes": {
        "verdict": "malicious"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

Just replace `"key_four"` with your actual API key if it differs. Once you run one of those commands, the vote will be submitted to VirusTotal. Let me know if you run into any issues!
